data.one_liner: Connect Flutter apps to Parse Server backends
data.what_it_does: Provides the Flutter SDK to connect to Parse Server and utilize the Parse Platform complete application stack. It handles communication with the backend and local storage of data using Sembast and shared preferences.
use_when: You are building a Flutter app backed by a Parse Server
You need offline data persistence using Parse objects
avoid_when: You are using a different backend provider like Firebase or Supabase
You do not need a backend client
strengths: Continuous testing with recent Flutter releases
Integrates local storage via Sembast and shared preferences
weaknesses: Tied specifically to the Parse Server ecosystem
data.setup_notes: Add the dependency to pubspec.yaml and follow the Parse Flutter SDK guide for initialization.

alternatives.name: supabase
alternatives.why_pick_it: Choose Supabase if you prefer an open source Firebase alternative with PostgreSQL instead of Parse Server.
